controles.affirmation: En mars 2026, quatre class actions ont ete deposees contre Costco pour obtenir le remboursement de tarifs payes au titre de l'IEEPA et repercutes sur les membres via des prix plus eleves (affaires Stockov, Gower, Ortiz, Briggs)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026 : "In March 2026, four class actions were filed against the Company seeking a refund of tariffs paid by the Company under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (“IEEPA”) that were passed on to members through higher prices. The complaints allege violations of state consumer protection laws and equitable doctrines: Stockov, et al. v. Costco Wholesale Corp., Case No. 26-cv-02734 (N.D. Illinois); Gower, et al. v. Costco Wholesale Corp., Case No. 26-2-08898-5SEA (King County Superior Court); Ortiz, et al. v. Costco Wholesale Corp., Case No. 3:26-cv-01164-CVR (D.P.R.); and Briggs, et al. v. Costco Wholesale Corp., Case No. 2:26-cv-01064 (W.D. Wash.). The Company has filed motions to dismiss in Stockov and Gower."

controles.affirmation: Costco reconnait que les tarifs douaniers sont plus susceptibles de nuire a ses resultats que de les ameliorer
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026 : "Government actions in various countries relating to tariffs affect the costs of some of our merchandise. The degree of our exposure is dependent on (among other things) the type of goods, rates imposed, and timing of the tariffs. Higher tariffs are more likely to adversely impact rather than improve our results."

controles.affirmation: Taux de renouvellement de 92,2% aux Etats-Unis et Canada et 89,7% mondial, penalises par la part croissante d'adhesions vendues en ligne
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026 : "At the end of the third quarter of 2026, our renewal rates were 92.2% in the U.S. and Canada and 89.7% worldwide. Renewal rates were negatively impacted by a higher number of memberships sold online, including through digital promotions, entering the renewal rate calculation. These memberships renew at a slightly lower rate on average."

controles.affirmation: Renouvellement mondial de 90,5% (T3 2024) a 90,2% (T3 2025) puis 89,7% (T3 2026), soit -0,8 point en deux ans ; US+Canada de 93,0% (T2 2025) a 92,2%
controles.verbatim_source: kpis-haut COST renewal_rate_worldwide : Q3-2024 90.5, Q3-2025 90.2, Q3-2026 89.7 ; renewal_rate_us_ca : Q2-2025 93.0, Q3-2026 92.2
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance mineure : la serie kpis-haut demarre a 88% en 2015-2016, l'affirmation "autour de 90-91% depuis 2015" est donc legerement optimiste sur le debut de periode. La tendance decrite reste exacte.

controles.affirmation: La hausse de cotisation de septembre 2024 explique encore environ 25% de la croissance des cotisations du T3 2026 (35% sur 36 semaines)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026 : "As previously reported, we increased our annual membership fees in the U.S. and Canada, effective September 1, 2024... The fee income increase accounted for approximately 25% and 35% of membership income growth during the third quarter and first thirty-six weeks of 2026."

controles.affirmation: 1 373 M$ de cotisations pour 2 815 M$ de resultat operationnel au T3 2026 (environ 49%) ; 5 323 M$ pour 10,39 Mds $ sur l'exercice 2025 (environ 51%) ; marge brute 11,04%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026 : Membership fees 1,373 ; Operating income 2,815 ; "Gross margin percentage 11.04". 10-K FY2025 : "Membership fee revenue increased 10% to $5,323" ; "Operating income 10,383"

controles.affirmation: Marge nette de 3,1% et marge operationnelle de 4,0% au T3 2026 (net income 2 192 M$ / revenu total 70 527 M$) ; croissance tiree par le ticket moyen (+7%) et les prix de l'essence (+221 points de base) plus que par la frequentation (+2%)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026 : Net income 2,192 ; Total revenue 70,527 (soit 3,11% et 3,99%) ; "Comparable sales were positively impacted by increases of approximately 7% and 5% in average ticket and 2% and 3% in shopping frequency in the third quarter and first thirty-six weeks of 2026" ; "Higher gasoline prices positively impacted net sales by $1,367, or 221 basis points"

controles.affirmation: Environ 86% des ventes et 84% du resultat operationnel proviennent des Etats-Unis et du Canada, et la Californie represente environ 26% des ventes americaines ; 928 entrepots
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 (Item 1A) : "our operational performance is highly dependent on our U.S. and Canadian operations, which comprised 86% and 84% of net sales and operating income in 2025. Within the U.S., we are highly dependent on our California operations, which comprised 26% of U.S. net sales in 2025... Any substantial slowing or sustained decline in these operations could materially adversely affect our business". 10-Q T3 FY2026 : "At May 10, 2026, Costco operated 928 warehouses worldwide"
controles.correction_proposee: L'affirmation est exacte, mais la "preuve" citee par l'ATT provient de data-lake/COST/risks/extracted.json qui resume a tort "86% du chiffre d'affaires ET du resultat operationnel". Citer directement le 10-K FY2025 (86% des ventes, 84% du resultat operationnel) plutot que le fichier de risques derive.
